🏢 MI HB 6391 — Michigan Could Slow Down New Data Centers

New data centers could face tougher reviews in Michigan. This bill establishes a process for local governments to assess the potential impacts of large-scale data centers – including noise, heat, and strain on emergency services – before approving construction.
